title: pro root scalar
statement: For n>0 invertible on Z, commutative rings R,A killed by n and a hom φ:R→A, let θ:ν*(R_Z(1))→Res(ν*(A_Z(1))) be normalized on pure root tensors through the comparison adjunction units. Then the pro-etale root map for R followed by forget(θ) equals the pro-etale root map for A [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data, sk-lem-geo-cartier].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Unfold the root map and cancel its common inverse roots comparison. Transpose the remaining maps under the abelian comparison adjunction. The forgetful comparison is itself the mate of the module comparison unit, so adjunction naturality reduces the equality to the specified tensor normalization at a=1. Ring homomorphisms preserve one.

lean.statement:
theorem pro_root_scalar (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {R A : Type (u + 1)}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (φ : R →+* A) (hR : (n : R) = 0) (hA : (n : A) = 0)
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    (θ : geoCartierLine R n hR Z ⟶
      (Sheaf.restrictScalars (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) φ).obj
        (geoCartierLine A n hA Z))
    (hθ : ∀ (W : Z.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : R) (z : (Z.rootsOfUnitySheaf n).obj.obj W),
      θ.hom.app ((Scheme.toProEt Z).op.obj W)
        (((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Z).unit.app
          (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z n R hR)).hom.app W
            (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator R n Z hR W a z)) =
      ((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).unit.app
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z n A hA)).hom.app W
          (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator A n Z hA W (φ a) z)) :
    cartierProRootMap R n hR Z hn hZ ≫ (cartierForget R Z).map θ =
      cartierProRootMap A n hA Z hn hZ
